meta.name: devloop
meta.description: Goal-driven development loop — define objective, write rules with key-results, verify visually, sync to issue tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按目标驱动开发，自动生成规则并同步到任务追踪
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从目标出发自动管理开发任务和验证结果
copy.tagline_en: Drive development by goals, auto-generate rules and sync to issue tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to manage development tasks and verification from objectives automatically

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按「目标→规则→编码→验证→同步」的循环工作。先定义目标和关键结果，编写规则文件，然后编码并用截图做视觉验证，最后将结果同步到问题追踪器。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新开发任务，需要结构化地定义目标、验证结果并同步到追踪器时触发。

say.text: 帮我为修复英文标签功能写一个 rule.yml
say.note: Claude 会生成包含目标和关键结果的规则文件。

say.text: 用 agent-browser 截图验证修改前后的页面
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器截图并对比是否达成目标。

say.text: 运行 x rule scan 检查代码合规性
say.note: Claude 会执行快速规则扫描。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a goal-driven loop: define objective and key results, write rule.yml, code, take before/after screenshots for visual verification, then sync everything to the issue tracker.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a new development task that requires structured goal definition, verification, and issue tracking.

say_en.text: Create a rule.yml for fixing English tags in Features section.
say_en.note: Claude generates a rule file with goal and key results.

say_en.text: Take before and after screenshots with agent-browser.
say_en.note: Claude opens the browser, screenshots, and compares.

say_en.text: Run x rule scan to check code compliance.
say_en.note: Claude executes a quick rule scan.
